run_train_text_to_image_lora: run fine-tuning of Kandinsky 2.2 decoder with LoRA on a text-to-image dataset
create_parse_args: create an argument parser for Kandinsky 2.2 LoRA fine-tuning with configurable training hyperparameters
build_lora_attn_processors: build LoRA attention processors for UNet cross-attention and self-attention layers
save_model_card: save a model card README with YAML metadata and example generated images for a LoRA checkpoint
test_validation_inference: test validation inference by generating images from a prompt using the fine-tuned LoRA pipeline
